candidates.item: Schema lists explicit expertise in: Answer Engine Optimization, AEO, SEO, Paid Media, Lead Generation, Multi-location SEO, B2B Marketing, AI Search Visibility, ChatGPT Optimization, Perplexity Optimization.
candidates.why_interesting: AEO — optimizing brands to be cited and quoted inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews — is a genuinely nascent service category. Industry roundups as of mid-2026 list only a handful of agencies explicitly offering it, and the space is crowded with SEO shops that have merely slapped 'AEO' onto existing content work. Skyward hard-codes ChatGPT Optimization and Perplexity Optimization as named schema skills, signalling they've planted a flag in AI-answer visibility specifically — not just SEO with a rebrand. That's a specific, verifiable stance worth reacting to.
